_meta.description: Planned --detail payload for uip maestro flow node configure on the Outlook 'email received' connector trigger. Placeholders marked with < > must be resolved before the command is run against a live tenant.
_meta.connectorKeyNote: Confirm the exact connector key by running: uip maestro flow registry search 'outlook email received' --output json --output-filter '[*].{NodeType:NodeType,DisplayName:DisplayName}'
_meta.configureCommand: uip maestro flow node configure <PROJECT>.flow <triggerId> --output json --detail "$(cat trigger_detail_payload.json)"

steps.2_getEnrichedMetadata: uip maestro flow registry get uipath.connector.trigger.<connector-key>.email-received --connection-id <CONNECTION_ID> --output json
steps.3_resolveParentFolderId: uip is resources run list "<connector-key>" "MailFolder" --connection-id <CONNECTION_ID> --output json
steps.4_verifyFilterFieldNames: Read filterFields.fields[].name from the registry get response above — verify 'from' and 'subject' are present before finalising the filter tree
